footer.note: Everything runs from this panel — no terminal needed. On the first Watch the panel compiles the bundled goanime-stream helper in the background (needs git + go) and then streams straight to mpv online — nothing is saved; until it is ready, Watch falls back to a temporary cache that is deleted after playback. Download / Download all save episodes to the downloads folder and keep running in the background.
